claims.claim: A Science study describes AlphaProof Nexus solving nine of 353 open Erdős problems, two unsolved for 56 years.
claims.episode_span: Nine open Erdős problems fell to Google DeepMind's proof system, two unsolved for fifty-six years.
claims.source_title: Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open math problems and actually got peer reviewed
claims.supporting_quote: AlphaProof Nexus cracked nine of 353 open Erdős problems, two unsolved for 56 years.

claims.claim: AlphaProof Nexus is built around Gemini 3.1 Pro, which drafts and revises proofs in Lean, and Lean checks each draft after every edit.
claims.episode_span: The system is built around Gemini 3.1 Pro, which drafts and revises proofs in the formal language Lean; Lean checks each draft after every edit, and the error messages guide the next attempt.
claims.source_title: Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open math problems and actually got peer reviewed
claims.supporting_quote: It's built around Gemini 3.1 Pro, which drafts and revises proofs in the formal language Lean. Lean checks each draft after every edit, and error messages guide the next attempt.

claims.claim: DeepMind reports the nine Erdős problems were solved even without calling AlphaProof.
claims.episode_span: For harder sub-problems it can call AlphaProof, though DeepMind reports the Erdős problems were solved even without that specialized tool.
claims.source_title: Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open math problems and actually got peer reviewed
claims.supporting_quote: Even without AlphaProof, it solved the nine Erdős problems, Google Deepmind reports.

claims.claim: AlphaProof Nexus proved 44 OEIS conjectures and improved a known bound in min-max optimization.
claims.episode_span: It also proved 44 conjectures from the OEIS integer-sequence database and improved a known bound in min-max optimization, a technique used to train some AI models.
claims.source_title: Google Deepmind's AlphaProof Nexus solved dozens of open math problems and actually got peer reviewed
claims.supporting_quote: Beyond that, AlphaProof Nexus proved 44 conjectures from the OEIS integer sequence database, solved an open question in algebraic geometry, and improved a known bound in min-max optimization, a technique used to train some AI models.

claims.claim: The team shared the solutions online ahead of the paper.
claims.episode_span: The team shared those solutions online ahead of the paper.

claims.supporting_quote: The team shared those solutions online ahead of the paper.
